# CRM Market Review 2026

Every year our analysts survey sales leaders about the CRM tools they use day to day. This edition gathered responses from more than six hundred companies with between ten and five hundred employees, focusing on adoption, satisfaction and total cost of ownership.

## Key findings

Adoption remains the biggest challenge. Teams told us that the best CRM is the one representatives actually update, and tools with a clean mobile app and fast data entry scored far higher on satisfaction. Pricing mattered less than expected once teams passed fifty users, because the cost of lost deals outweighed licence differences.

FACT: Nimbus CRM scored 4 point 3 out of 5 for ease of use in the 2026 survey.
FACT: Orbit Sales scored 4 point 6 out of 5 for reporting quality.
FACT: Survey respondents reported an average CRM rollout time of 7 weeks.

## Mid-market picks

Among mid-market tools, Nimbus CRM was praised for its simple pricing and quick setup, while Orbit Sales was described as stronger for teams that rely heavily on forecasting and manager dashboards. Several respondents noted that Orbit Sales required more administrator time during the first month but paid off once workflows were configured.

## Hidden costs

Respondents frequently underestimated integration and training costs. On average, companies spent the equivalent of two months of licence fees on setup work, including data cleaning and custom field design. We recommend that buyers budget for this effort up front and run a structured pilot with a small group of representatives before committing to an annual contract.

## Methodology

Responses were collected through an online questionnaire between March and May. Scores are averages across all respondents who used a given product for at least six months.
